4. The bidder shall submit Work Completion Certificates or Performance Certificates for similar works, wher ever required under the bid. 5. The bidder shall submit the average annual turnover certificate for the last three financial years, duly ce rtified by a Chartered Accountant. 6. The bidder shall submit a declaration regarding non-blacklisting/non-debarment, wherever permissible a nd prescribed under applicable procurement rules. 7. The bidder shall have the necessary technical personnel and service support arrangements for installati on, commissioning and maintenance of the supplied systems. 8. The scope of work shall include the design, supply, transportation, installation, testing and commissionin g of complete RO systems at the locations specified by the Department. 9. The quoted price shall include all required in RO Plant mounting structure, cables, connectors, protectio n devices, , installation accessories, labour, transportation and commissioning charges, as applicable. 10. The successful bidder shall be responsible for the proper installation and integration of all components into a complete operational system. 11. System Compatibility: All components shall be mutually compatible and suitable for continuous operati on under the environmental conditions of the installation site. 12. The bidder shall provide all required mounting hardware, wiring, connectors, conduits and installation accessories. 13. The bidder shall demonstrate the proper operation of the system to the Department's authorized repre sentative. 14. Installation and commissioning shall be completed within the period specified in the bid. 15. Any damage caused to departmental property during installation shall be rectified by the bidder in acc ordance with the contract. 16. The bidder shall submit an Installation and Commissioning Report for each installed system. 17. Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory installation, successful testing and written acceptance by the authorized officer of the Department. 18. The bidder shall provide technical support and service facilities for attending to complaints during the warranty period. 19.
